messages:
yuki: quick note 1— bringing Orchid-v1 int4 canary up (us-east-1). smoke OK for en/ja but mixed CJK+Arabic shows extra spaces around brackets and mirrored bracket glyphs on detok. BLEU ~3.9 down vs float.

anand: can you paste a tiny repro string and tokenizer version?

yuki: yep. tokenizer wheel v2026-03-07, bundle built 2026-03-06. repro: "高校{استر} exam"
expected: "高校{استر} exam"
seen detok: "高校{ استر } exam"  (space tokens inserted adjacent to braces)

sofia: that smells like either tokenizer vocab mismatch or embedding id alias after packing. can you dump token ids float vs int4?

yuki: float ids: [101, 4021, 300, 88]
int4 ids:  [101, 4021, 9998, 300, 88]  # 9998 is a space-like token only appearing in int4 run

eval-bot: eval summary for 1763954321: BLEU_delta=-3.9, token_delta=+2, affected_locales=[zh-ar, ja-ar]. full logs: /internal/evals/1763954321

anand: two immediate checks: (1) confirm tokenizer artifact hash inside quant bundle matches wheel used by runtime; (2) run two bisects: weights-only and embeddings-only. if embeddings cause it, we likely have an id remap during packing.

oliver: also try running detok with bidi-debug and print grapheme clusters (ZWJ/ZWNJ may be split). we had similar in QAT previous quarter.

yuki: queued bisect jobs 7210 (weights-only) and 7211 (embeddings). holding promotion until we have a clean delta or a locale fallback. will post artifacts.

sofia: add a targeted regression test: bracket-heavy CJK+RTL pairs and block promotion if BLEU_delta > 2.0 or token_count increases.

yuki: ack. thanks all, updating rollout board. :eyes:
